invariants.rule: No Grade 3/4 citation may contain the phrase 'Michigan Personal Finance', a PF1-PF7 code, or any claim that Michigan publishes elementary personal finance standards.
invariants.scope: Checked against required_label, i.e. the post-relabel state. The release as it stands TODAY still carries 'Michigan Personal Finance foundations — introductory' on 72 citations; that is what authored_class records, and this invariant does not claim otherwise.

invariants.rule: No Ready for Life citation may assert Michigan authorship, adoption, approval or alignment-as-standard. Supporting connection wording only.
invariants.scope: Every ready-for-life record in the registry, changed or not.

invariants.rule: A CROSSWALK_SUPPORTING citation must name at least one official anchor carrying doc_id, locator and a quote presence-checked against held bytes, and must record governing authority manuel-academy.
invariants.scope: Every record whose policy_class is CROSSWALK_SUPPORTING.

invariants.rule: Any substring a citation presents as an official topic, standard or code name must be byte-present in the cited document.
invariants.scope: Every relabelled record in every subject, via its resolution's label_official_names. Each entry must be a substring of required_label AND its byte_form must be present in the named held document.

invariants.rule: MDE SEL Competencies and Indicators (2017) may be cited as a supporting framework and never as an academic standard.
invariants.scope: Two executed checks: the document's own self-positioning sentence is byte-present, and no ready-for-life record carries authority michigan-mde. The further fact that the document is absent from the MDE Academic Standards index is a WEB OBSERVATION, recorded in source-custody.json, not an executed check.
invariants.execution: executed-in-part; index absence is a web observation

invariants.rule: A citation naming a Michigan health topic must use the topic name printed on the topic list; expansions of it are not official names.
invariants.scope: Subsumed by I4; kept as the health-specific statement of the same rule.
